Perfume rating 4.42 out of 5 with 16,037 votes

Reviews (1.8K)

Liquid Brun by French Avenue is a Woody fragrance for men. Liquid Brun was launched in 2024. Top notes are Cinnamon, Orange Blossom, Cardamom and Bergamot; middle notes are Bourbon Vanilla and elemi; base notes are Praline, Ambroxan, Musk and Guaiac Wood.

Read about this perfume in other languages: Deutsch, Español, Français, Italiano, Magyar, Nederlands, Polski, Português, Română, Srpski, Svenska, Türkçe, Čeština, Ελληνικά, Монгол, Русский, Українська, עברית, العربية, 日本語, 汉语, 한국어.

What People Say

Pros

Perfect for cold weather and dates

Exceptional value for the price

98% accurate PDM Althaïr clone

Addictive vanilla and cinnamon gourmand

Premium packaging and heavy bottle

Balanced unisex profile with masculine lean

Strong projection and room-filling sillage

Lasts 10+ hours on skin

Massive compliment getter in public

Indistinguishable from Althaïr in the air

Outperforms the original Parfums de Marly

Cons

Too sweet and heavy for summer

Overpowering sweetness if oversprayed

Potentially cloying in small spaces

Requires weeks of maceration for performance

Aggressive ambroxan can be nose-stinging

Harsh initial alcohol blast

Synthetic or medicinal quality up close

Batch inconsistencies reported by users

Linear scent profile lacks transitions

Awkward and unappealing product name

Reported notes of burnt rubber or plastic

Note: These pros and cons are AI-generated from member reviews and may be inaccurate. Please read full reviews and consider your own needs before purchasing.
